virat_kohli.name: Virat Kohli
virat_kohli.key_achievements: ICC Cricketer of the Decade, 2011 World Cup Winner, 2013 Champions Trophy, 2024 T20 World Cup Champion
virat_kohli.bio: One of the greatest batsmen in modern cricket history, renowned for supreme chasing abilities, unmatched consistency, and aggressive leadership.

rohit_sharma.name: Rohit Sharma
rohit_sharma.key_achievements: 2024 T20 World Cup Winning Captain, Only player with three ODI double centuries (264 highest score), 5 IPL Titles
rohit_sharma.bio: Indian national team captain and explosive opening batter with effortless timing, holding the world record for the highest individual score in ODIs (264).

ms_dhoni.name: MS Dhoni
ms_dhoni.key_achievements: Only Captain to win all three ICC Trophies (2007 T20 WC, 2011 ODI WC, 2013 Champions Trophy), 5 IPL Titles
ms_dhoni.bio: Regarded as one of the greatest captains and finishers in cricket history. Master tactician behind the stumps with lightning-fast stumpings.

sachin_tendulkar.name: Sachin Tendulkar
sachin_tendulkar.key_achievements: Highest run-scorer in international cricket, Only player with 100 International Centuries, 2011 World Cup Winner
sachin_tendulkar.bio: Revered globally as the 'God of Cricket'. Holder of virtually every major batting record in the history of international cricket.

jasprit_bumrah.name: Jasprit Bumrah
jasprit_bumrah.key_achievements: Player of the Tournament 2024 T20 World Cup, Fastest Indian pacer to 100 Test & ODI wickets, Lethal death over yorkers
jasprit_bumrah.bio: World's premier fast bowler across all formats, famous for his unique bowling action, pinpoint yorkers, and deceptive slower balls.

hardik_pandya.name: Hardik Pandya
hardik_pandya.key_achievements: Defended final over in 2024 T20 World Cup Final, IPL Winning Captain (2022)
hardik_pandya.bio: Dynamic fast-bowling all-rounder with fearless power hitting in the death overs and crucial match-winning bowling breakthroughs.

ravindra_jadeja.name: Ravindra Jadeja
ravindra_jadeja.key_achievements: 2013 Champions Trophy Golden Ball, 2024 T20 World Cup Champion, World-class direct-hit fielding
ravindra_jadeja.bio: World-class three-dimensional all-rounder with lethal spin bowling, clutch lower-order batting, and unmatched athletic fielding.

shubman_gill.name: Shubman Gill
shubman_gill.key_achievements: Youngest double-centurion in ODI history (208 vs NZ), 2018 U19 World Cup Player of the Tournament, IPL Orange Cap 2023
shubman_gill.bio: Generational batting prodigy celebrated for silky strokeplay, classical technique, and record-breaking run accumulation.

kl_rahul.name: KL Rahul
kl_rahul.key_achievements: Century in all three international formats, Key anchor of 2023 World Cup campaign with 450+ runs
kl_rahul.bio: Technically gifted versatile batter and reliable wicketkeeper, capable of opening or stabilizing the middle order in crunch games.

rishabh_pant.name: Rishabh Pant
rishabh_pant.key_achievements: Historic 89* at Gabba 2021 to win Border-Gavaskar Trophy, 2024 T20 World Cup Champion, Miracle comeback after car crash
rishabh_pant.bio: Audacious and fearless left-handed counter-attacking wicketkeeper-batter with match-winning heroics in SENA countries.
